info.title: Voyant Operator API
info.description: Generated from the composed operator app. Do not edit by hand.

200.description: The proposal version with updated validity

post.description: Expire every sent proposal version past its validity date. Accepts an optional `now` JSON body; an empty or absent body is accepted. The body is parsed in the handler (not as a declared OpenAPI request body) because Hono's JSON validator would reject a zero-length `application/json` request before the handler runs.

200.description: The proposal version with the applied trip snapshot

post.description: Send a proposal version for client review. Accepts an optional `validUntil` JSON body; an empty or absent body is accepted. The body is parsed in the handler (not as a declared OpenAPI request body) because Hono's JSON validator would reject a zero-length `application/json` request before the handler runs.

200.description: The proposal version marked as viewed

post.description: Accept a sent proposal version. Accepts an optional JSON body; an empty or absent body is accepted. The body is parsed in the handler (not as a declared OpenAPI request body) because Hono's JSON validator would reject a zero-length `application/json` request before the handler runs.

200.description: The accepted proposal version and its proposal

post.description: Decline a sent proposal version. Accepts an optional JSON body; an empty or absent body is accepted. The body is parsed in the handler (not as a declared OpenAPI request body) because Hono's JSON validator would reject a zero-length `application/json` request before the handler runs.
